model.name: R20.13: CurrentSprint is a dedicated class that sets the chain and is used by planner's skill as planning+driving tool.
model.description: CurrentSprint = a DEDICATED typed CLASS in the trace model (Object.verb pattern). It is MAINTAINED (kept current with the active WIP=1 work). It SETS THE CHAIN = defines the active narrow chain (req→uc→class→method→impl→test) for the current task. The PLANNER'S SKILL uses it as BOTH: (a) a PLANNING tool (define/set which chain is active — planner.setCurrentChain), and (b) a DRIVING tool (drive that chain across roles to delivery — planner.advanceChain). Methods: setChain(req,task), pinCurrent(), advance(), getActiveChain(). The class is a scenario unit (ior:class:CurrentSprint) maintained in the index.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the current sprint should be a dedicated class that is maintained and sets the chain by a planners skill to use it as planning and driving tool."
model.crossRefNote: R20.12 (sprint pinned at top) is the UI manifestation. R20.13 is the CLASS/MODEL that drives it — CurrentSprint owns the data, R20.12 renders it.

intendedChain.useCase: currentSprint.setChain — CurrentSprint class defines and maintains the active WIP=1 chain, used by planner skill for planning+driving
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) CurrentSprint.setChain(req, task) → assert activeChain populated with req→uc→class→method→impl→test path. (2) planner skill invokes CurrentSprint.pinCurrent() → sprint-list shows it. (3) advance() transitions the chain state.
